protocol.title: Direct Detection and Drug-Resistance Profiling of Bacteremias Using Inertial Microfluidics
protocol.platform: Inertial microfluidics (Dean Flow Fractionation) + NanoString hybridization-based RNA detection
protocol.objective: Label-free isolation of bacteria from whole blood by Dean Flow Fractionation and direct pathogen identification by rRNA hybridization, with antibiotic susceptibility determination by mRNA transcriptional profiling

device.material: Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) on glass, fabricated by standard soft lithography

bacterial_outlet.collects: bacteria and platelets (Dean-migrated to outer wall)

waste_outlet.collects: RBCs and leukocytes (inertially focused at inner wall)

device.operating_principle: Dean Flow Fractionation (DFF): Dean drag (F_D) migrates all particles toward inner wall; larger cells (RBCs ~6-8 um; leukocytes ~7-12 um) experience additional inertial lift (F_L, dominant when ap/h > 0.07) and remain focused at inner wall. Bacteria (<1 um, ap/h << 0.07) complete a full Dean Cycle (DC1) and recirculate to outer wall, exiting at the bacterial outlet.
device.bonding: Irreversible air plasma bonding of PDMS to glass slide

operating_conditions.scalability: Multiple chips in parallel for higher throughput

reagents.sample_buffer: 1x PBS + 0.1% bovine serum albumin (BSA, Miltenyi Biotec); BSA prevents non-specific adsorption to tubing and channel walls
reagents.blood_anticoagulant: EDTA (fresh human whole blood, Research Blood Components, Brighton MA)
reagents.lysis_buffer: RLT buffer (Qiagen) with beta-mercaptoethanol, 4x excess by volume

separation_performance.detection_at_low_load: 100% detection in all 20 samples spiked at 10-50 cfu/mL
separation_performance.leukocyte_removal: ~10^7/mL leukocytes removed; reduces background for nucleic acid detection
separation_performance.platelet_recovery_at_bacterial_outlet_pc: ~40 (larger size ~2-3 um causes higher Stokes drag, slower Dean migration)

rna_detection.probe_design: Two adjacent 50-nt probes per target; one biotinylated, one fluorescent barcode (4 colors x 7 positions)
rna_detection.normalization: Positive and negative control probes provided by manufacturer (nSolver software)
rna_detection.lysis_protocol: Pellet at 16,000 x g; resuspend in 50 uL 1x PBS; lyse with 4x RLT+BME, vortex, 5 min RT; use immediately or store at -80 C

steps.name: Blood sample preparation
steps.operation: mix (1:3 dilution of whole blood with PBS+BSA; bacteria spiked immediately before loading)
steps.notes: BSA at 0.1% prevents non-specific adsorption. Bacteria spiked as clinical isolates grown to mid-log phase in LB or THB. For blood culture route: BACTEC bottle inoculated at 1 cfu/mL, incubated 7.5 h at 37 C to reach >1e5 cfu/mL.

steps.name: Device priming with sheath fluid
steps.operation: mix (sheath flow introduced at inner inlet to pin sample stream at outer wall)
steps.notes: Sheath fluid confines blood sample near outer wall at inlet. Pre-wets channel to remove air bubbles and conditions walls.

steps.name: Dean Flow Fractionation separation
steps.operation: mix (continuous-flow spiral microchannel; abstracted from DMF electrode mixing)
steps.dean_cycle: DC1 (one full recirculation from outer → inner → outer wall)
steps.notes: Bacteria and platelets complete DC1 and exit at bacterial outlet. RBCs and leukocytes are inertially focused at inner wall and exit at waste outlet. No labelling, no affinity capture.

steps.name: Bacterial eluate concentration
steps.operation: heat (models centrifugation at 16,000 x g and resuspension in 50 uL PBS)
steps.notes: Pellet collected; supernatant removed. Resuspension concentrates bacteria ~20-fold relative to eluate volume.

steps.name: Bacterial recovery QC
steps.operation: detect (bacterialRecoveryQC module; abstracts cfu enumeration on LB agar)
steps.verification_method: Colony forming unit (cfu) count on LB agar plates after serial dilution

steps.name: Bacterial lysis for RNA extraction
steps.operation: mix + heat (vigorous vortex with 4x RLT+BME; 5 min RT)
steps.notes: RLT denatures proteins and inactivates RNases. BME reduces disulfide bonds. Crude lysate used directly as NanoString input without purification.

steps.name: NanoString rRNA hybridization for species identification
steps.operation: heat (hybridization at 65 C for 2 h; detection by nCounter Digital Analyzer)
steps.rRNA_abundance_advantage: >1000-fold excess over most abundant mRNA; enables detection without amplification

probeset.alignment_method: ClustalOmega multiple sequence alignment of 5S, 16S, 23S rRNA

steps.organism_score: Geometric mean of species-specific probe counts / sum of all geometric means
steps.sensitivity_cfu_mL: ~100 (from 3 mL whole blood processed by DFF)
steps.note_on_whole_blood: Direct detection from unprocessed whole blood gives uninterpretable hybridization pattern due to blood product interference. DFF pre-processing is mandatory.

steps.name: Susceptibility sample preparation and blood culture enrichment
steps.operation: mix + heat (1:3 blood dilution; optional BACTEC pre-enrichment at 37 C for 7.5 h)

route_A_direct_spike.description: E. coli spiked at 1e5 cfu/mL directly into 1 mL whole blood

route_B_blood_culture.description: BACTEC bottle inoculated at 1 cfu/mL; incubated 7.5 h at 37 C to reach >1e5 cfu/mL
route_B_blood_culture.advantage: Simulates clinical blood culture bottles used in microbiology labs; still faster than standard VITEK-2 pipeline (>1e6 cfu/mL needed)

steps.notes: Both susceptible and resistant clinical E. coli isolates processed identically. Classification resolved downstream by Transcriptional Susceptibility Score.

steps.name: DFF separation for susceptibility workflow
steps.operation: mix (same spiral DFF device; 1700 uL/min; 20 min per mL)
steps.post_separation: heat at 25 C for 5 min (centrifugation and concentration)
steps.notes: Same separation parameters as rRNA workflow. Both arms processed in parallel.

steps.name: Ciprofloxacin exposure
steps.operation: mix + heat (ciprofloxacin added to concentrated bacterial fractions; 37 C for 30 min)
steps.mechanism: In susceptible organisms: ciprofloxacin induces upregulation of 6 stress-response mRNA transcripts. In resistant organisms: transcriptional response is absent at this concentration.
steps.notes: 30 min is sufficient to generate a detectable transcriptional differential without extensive bacterial growth. Both isolates exposed identically.

steps.name: Lysis and NanoString mRNA hybridization for susceptibility determination
steps.operation: mix + heat (lysis at 25 C for 5 min; hybridization at 65 C for 2 h)

probeset.normalization: Responsive transcripts normalized to geometric mean of control transcript expression (same hybridization assay, same lysate)

transcriptional_susceptibility_score.description: Analogous to Squared Pyramidal Distance metric; derivation set of clinical E. coli strains (susceptible and resistant) defines score 0 (susceptible centroid) and score 1 (resistant centroid). Unknown projected onto vector between centroids.
transcriptional_susceptibility_score.separation_criterion: Dashed line = 4 SD from susceptible derivation cohort mean

steps.sensitivity_cfu_mL: ~1e5 (limited by mRNA abundance vs rRNA; >1 order of magnitude better than VITEK-2 threshold of >1e6 cfu/mL)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Sample prep (1:3 blood dilution, bacterial spike), device priming, DFF separation (20 min/mL), eluate concentration, recovery QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(recoverySignal); lysis (RLT+BME, 25 C, 5 min); rRNA hybridization (65 C, 120 min); rRNA detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(rRNASignal); susceptibility sample prep (both arms); blood culture enrichment (37 C, 450 min); DFF separation; ciprofloxacin exposure (37 C, 30 min); lysis; mRNA hybridization (65 C, 120 min); mRNA detect
